rows.title: Agent Details
rows.description: All users in the permitted tenant, with their declared role and role capabilities; no credentials are exported.
limitations: Internal sales-office assignments are not recorded. Office is unknown; the role description does not override endpoint-specific authorization.

rows.title: APIS Data
rows.description: Flight passenger documents, dates of birth and document completeness, including passengers with missing data.
limitations: This is a protected document report, not an authority submission or acknowledgment.

rows.title: Confirmed Passengers
rows.description: Confirmed and completed sector members for a specific flight.

rows.title: Currencies
rows.description: Configured currency catalog and every persisted exchange-rate record, with source, validity and explicit missing current rates.

rows.title: Daily Flight Load
rows.description: One UTC departure day with booked, checked-in, boarded, offloaded and recorded no-show counts.
limitations: No-shows are reported only after an explicit DCS close. Boarding is local attendance evidence, not external ticket uplift.

rows.title: Eticket Status
rows.description: Current coupon states for a specified local ticket number.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

rows.title: ETL Processing
rows.description: Accepted handler ETL receipts and their processed coupons.
limitations: Production handler ETL acceptance and the daily accepted/rejected receipt register are not available.

rows.title: Eticket Values
rows.description: Local documents created in a UTC period with their traceable fare-component lines.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.

rows.title: Eticket Value (PNR)
rows.description: All local ticket coupons and monetary source lines for a specified PNR or booking reference.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.

rows.title: Expired Tickets
rows.description: Documents whose authoritative validity period has expired.
limitations: Document validity dates and the operator's expiry policy are not recorded. Booking or payment expiry is not ticket expiry.

rows.title: Fares Departing City
rows.description: Filed fare-class rules applicable to the specified origin airport, including unrestricted rules and each rule's validity and pricing terms.
limitations: The system stores relative fare-class/rule pricing, not an independently filed final fare amount. This is a configuration report, not a passenger quote. Tenant attribution uses airlines with flights owned by that tenant.

rows.title: Fares City Pair
rows.description: Filed fare-class rules for the specified directional airport pair, including route-wide rules.
limitations: The system stores relative fare-class/rule pricing, not an independently filed final fare amount. This is a configuration report, not a passenger quote. Tenant attribution uses airlines with flights owned by that tenant.

rows.title: FAX Information
rows.description: Airport FAX directory information.
limitations: No authoritative airport FAX directory is recorded; SSR/OSI APFAX is a different report.

rows.title: Flown Load
rows.description: Local DCS boarded passenger counts for flights with recorded off-block movement or completed status.
limitations: Only recorded boardings are counted. Completed flight status alone never implies a passenger flew or a coupon was uplifted.

rows.title: Flight Availability 1 Day
rows.description: All flights in one UTC day with cabin capacity and effective availability after unexpired holds.

rows.title: Flight Availability 1 Week
rows.description: All flights in seven UTC days starting on the chosen date, including unexpired holds.

rows.title: Flight Manifest
rows.description: Passenger, booking, current local coupon, sector seat and attributed baggage details.
limitations: Ticket and coupon fields describe AIS local documents. They do not certify external carrier issuance, uplift or settlement.
Ambiguous or missing coupon identities are shown explicitly. Returned bags are excluded; unresolved physical registrations block the manifest.

rows.title: Flight List
rows.description: Alternative flight passenger list using current sector membership.

rows.title: Flight Count
rows.description: Passenger counts for one flight, with route, dates, cabin and passenger types.

rows.title: Flight Count
rows.description: Passenger detail with distinct booking reference, PNR and passenger type.

rows.title: Flight Group
rows.description: Inventory across an operational multi-leg flight group.
limitations: The system has booking itineraries but no authoritative operational flight-group identity. An itinerary is not a flight group.

rows.title: Flight ID
rows.description: Operational details of a flight by database identifier.

rows.title: Flight Complete List
rows.description: Passengers retaining inventory, plus unallocated active holds clearly separated from named reservations.
limitations: Unallocated holds have no passenger or PNR; they are shown with empty identity fields and their seat quantity.

rows.title: Flight Passengers By Office
rows.description: Passengers grouped by the office that created the booking.
limitations: Historical booking-origin sales-office identity is not recorded; user and agency identity cannot substitute for it.

rows.title: Flight Passenger Table
rows.description: Passenger list selected by the flight database identifier.

rows.title: Flight Times
rows.description: Departure and arrival times for flights from a specified origin airport during a UTC period.

rows.title: Flight Counts
rows.description: Distinct passenger and current local ticketed-passenger counts for each flight.
limitations: Ticket and coupon fields describe AIS local documents. They do not certify external carrier issuance, uplift or settlement.

rows.title: Form Of Payments
rows.description: Payment records by creation period and method, with current attempt status.
limitations: The system has no authoritative sales/issue-office relationship. Office is unknown; an agency or sales channel is not substituted for an office.
Payment attempts are separate from settled ledger movements.

rows.title: Frequent Flyer Activity
rows.description: Every recorded miles transaction in the UTC creation period, including member, type, signed miles and balance after the transaction.

rows.title: Frequent Flyer Membership
rows.description: Members whose recorded membership start falls in the UTC period; member ID is the user's ID.

rows.title: Frequent Flyer Transactions
rows.description: All recorded transactions for the selected member (user ID), optionally restricted by UTC creation period and transaction type.

rows.title: GDS Bookings
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: GDS Etickets
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: GDS ID
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: GDS PNR Quantity
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: GDS Segments
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: GDS Travel Agent ID
rows.description: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.
limitations: Requires accepted provider booking receipts and their explicit AIS booking, ticket and sector links. Technical GDS messages and local agency bookings are not accepted GDS sales.

rows.title: Interline Etickets
rows.description: Accepted IATA IET documents and bookings.
limitations: Accepted interline issue receipts and coupon mappings are not available.

rows.title: Interline IDEC Files
rows.description: Transactions in an accepted IDEC file.
limitations: An accepted IDEC specification, importer and partner file receipt are required.

rows.title: Interline Values
rows.description: Actual interline coupon values and settlement shares.
limitations: Accepted interline coupon and settlement evidence is required; a prorate estimate is insufficient.

rows.title: Issues Offices
rows.description: Internal ticket-issuing offices.
limitations: No issuing-office entity or immutable issuing-office attribution is recorded. Travel agencies and provider office identifiers cannot substitute for it.

rows.title: Last Record Locator
rows.description: Newest non-deleted booking in scope, ordered by creation time then booking ID. Includes pending, confirmed, completed and cancelled bookings.

rows.title: Lifted Tickets
rows.description: Local coupons with recorded uplift proof, selected by flight departure date.
limitations: Only an F coupon with exactly one matching persisted coupon_uplift receipt is included. Check-in, boarding and completed flight status alone are insufficient. Production uplift ingestion remains subject to external acceptance.

rows.title: Load Factors
rows.description: Recorded sold inventory divided by physical capacity; holds and effective availability are separate.
limitations: The load factor measures booked inventory, not flown passengers; zero-capacity flights have a null factor.

rows.title: Load Overbookings
rows.description: Flights with recorded sold inventory at or above 100% of physical capacity.
limitations: Unexpired holds are displayed separately and do not turn into sold seats.

rows.title: Message Table
rows.description: Configured operational Type-B message routes and the application's SMS template catalog, with configuration and acceptance state kept separate.
limitations: There is no unified persisted registry of email templates. SMS templates do not prove that a delivery provider is configured or accepted.

rows.title: Migration Report
rows.description: Booking import batch errors.
limitations: No booking-import batch/source-row/error workflow is recorded. Database schema migrations and forensic audits are different operations.

rows.title: No Seat Plan
rows.description: Flights with missing or incomplete allocated seat inventory, or an invalid, mismatched or ambiguous allocated seat map.
limitations: A matching catalog map alone does not prove that it was allocated to a flight.

rows.title: No Tickets
rows.description: Reservations holding inventory with no current local coupon for any passenger on that sector.
limitations: Ticket and coupon fields describe AIS local documents. They do not certify external carrier issuance, uplift or settlement.
Legacy ticket numbers without coupon records are marked unverified and are not called proven unticketed.

rows.title: No Ticket or Time Limit
rows.description: Inventory-holding reservations without a ticket or an authoritative ticketing time limit.
limitations: Commercial ticketing time limits are not recorded. Inventory-lock expiry is not a ticketing time limit.

rows.title: Sales Offices
rows.description: Internal sales offices.
limitations: No tenant-owned sales-office entity is recorded. Travel agencies are distinct from airline sales offices.

rows.title: Sales Office Credit Limits
rows.description: Credit limits assigned to internal sales offices.
limitations: No sales-office credit account or office assignment exists. Agency and corporate credit are separate accounts.

rows.title: Passengers
rows.description: Passengers on a specific flight with cabin, type, booking reference and PNR.

rows.title: Passenger Summary
rows.description: Passenger counts by flight, route, date, cabin and adult/child/infant type.

rows.title: Payments
rows.description: All authorized payment records in a UTC creation period, including method, provider and current status.
limitations: A payment record is not proof of settlement. Use the ledger-movement report for cash and non-cash settlement.

rows.title: PNL (Passenger Name List)
rows.description: Generate an operator-template PNL draft from authorized flight members and a configured route.
limitations: The generated draft is downloadable report content. It is not persisted, queued, sent or acknowledged by this read operation.
A configured Type-B address and valid Latin document names are required; carrier acceptance remains separate.

rows.title: PNL Status
rows.description: Every flight in a departure period from an origin airport, with each recorded outbound PNL version and its actual transport status.
limitations: Flights without a stored PNL are shown as not_generated. Draft, sent and acknowledged are separate recorded states; this report does not send messages.

rows.title: PNR 50
rows.description: Latest 50 non-deleted bookings in scope, ordered by creation time then booking ID. Fewer rows are returned when fewer exist.

rows.title: PNR Full (Passenger Name Record)
rows.description: Unified local booking snapshot: booking, passengers, sectors, local coupons, payments, fare components, ancillary purchases and recorded history, with an explicit record type per row.
limitations: Only allowlisted local business fields are included. Provider credentials, payment payloads, raw audit values and passenger travel documents are excluded. External issuance and unrecorded historic events are not inferred.

rows.title: PNR History
rows.description: Unified local timeline of booking creation, state transitions, payment events, servicing requests, ledger entries and booking audit events. The period filters event time.
limitations: The report preserves source identifiers and separate events; it does not claim that every historical action produced an event. Raw audit values, provider payloads and free-text error details are excluded.

rows.title: PNR from Credit Card Authorization
rows.description: Find a booking by the card issuer's authorization code.
limitations: No authoritative card authorization code is recorded. Payment-intent IDs and gateway transaction IDs are not authorization codes.

rows.title: PNR Table
rows.description: Unified local booking snapshots for all current booking-sector members of the selected flight. Legacy bookings are included only when they have no sector rows.
limitations: Uses the same allowlisted local fields as PNR Full. External issuance and unrecorded historical events are not inferred.

rows.title: Product Sales
rows.description: Every funded ancillary purchase, by its recorded funding time, including product, booking, quantity, snapshot prices and current cancellation/refund state.
limitations: Rows are funded purchases, including authorized no-charge purchases. Product-level cash collections and net refund allocation are not independently recorded. Historic rows without funding evidence are excluded; sale-currency snapshots are unavailable and catalog currency is labelled separately.

rows.title: Passport Data
rows.description: Protected passport and travel-document details for passengers departing the specified origin airport in a UTC period.
limitations: Origin selects an airport by IATA code. Missing and unverified documents remain explicit; document records do not prove authority acceptance.

rows.title: PNR's on Queues
rows.description: Membership of bookings in operational reservation queues.
limitations: No reservation queue or PNR queue-membership workflow exists. Background job queues are not reservation queues.

rows.title: Remittances
rows.description: Receipted transfers from a sales office.
limitations: No authoritative sales-office remittance register exists.

rows.title: Revenue Post Departure
rows.description: Uplifted local coupon component values by flight date, retaining their proof references.
limitations: The system has no authoritative sales/issue-office relationship. Office is unknown; an agency or sales channel is not substituted for an office.

Only an F coupon with exactly one matching persisted coupon_uplift receipt is included. Check-in, boarding and completed flight status alone are insufficient. Production uplift ingestion remains subject to external acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.

Booked, local-document and uplift amounts describe separately dated commercial component values. They are not recognized accounting revenue. Bookings without a fare-component snapshot cannot contribute a value; this is not the full invoice or ledger total. Revenue recognition remains unknown pending funding, tax, loyalty allocation and accepted carrier evidence reconciliation.

rows.title: Refunds
rows.description: Posted refund and partial-refund ledger entries by transaction date, keeping cash and non-cash tenders distinct.
limitations: The system has no authoritative sales/issue-office relationship. Office is unknown; an agency or sales channel is not substituted for an office.

rows.title: Reported Sales By Office

limitations: The system has no authoritative sales/issue-office relationship. Office is unknown; an agency or sales channel is not substituted for an office.

rows.title: Reported Sales System Wide
rows.description: All posted booking ledger movements by transaction date, including charges and their refund reversals.
limitations: This is a settlement movement register. A settlement does not establish the ticket sale/issue event required for full equivalence.

rows.title: Reported Excess Baggage Sales
rows.description: Funded baggage product line items with their recorded funding reference and lifecycle state.
limitations: The system has no authoritative sales/issue-office relationship. Office is unknown; an agency or sales channel is not substituted for an office.
The product catalogue identifies baggage but does not classify airport excess-weight sales. Excess classification and net item refund allocation remain unknown.

rows.title: Reservations By Flight Date
rows.description: Reservations selected by sector departure date, including multi-sector bookings and their creation date.

rows.title: Reservations Without Tickets

Missing coupon evidence and legacy unverified ticket identities are separate exception reasons.

rows.title: Restricted Flights

rows.title: RO Reports
rows.description: Full cabin and configured RBD inventory by flight, with holds, waitlist and effective physical availability.
limitations: Cabin totals and RBD subsets are separate levels and must not be added together. Waitlists are recorded by cabin, not by RBD.

rows.title: Sales
rows.description: Local document creation records with the actual linked agency, coupon and traceable component values.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.
Agency attribution uses the unique agent-booking relation; it is not a GDS or office attribution.

rows.title: Sales All
rows.description: Local ticket document records and components by their recorded creation date.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.
Original sale timestamps and every exchange/reversal-to-document monetary mapping remain unavailable.

rows.title: Sales by City
rows.description: Sales grouped by the city of the actual point of sale.
limitations: No authoritative point-of-sale city is stored. A flight's origin city cannot replace it.

rows.title: Tax Codes
rows.description: Configured operator-approved tax codes and effective policies.
limitations: The application has offer tax estimates, not an operator-approved tax-code registry.

rows.title: Ticket Calculation
rows.description: All recorded local coupon calculations and source components, including unmapped and reversed lines.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.

rows.title: Ticket Coupons
rows.description: Details of one ticket/coupon, its current state, monetary source lines and matching uplift receipt.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.

Amounts are integer minor units in the stated currency. Fare components are commercial source lines, not approved tax determinations. OFFER_TAX_ESTIMATE remains an estimate. Booking-level or ambiguously mapped lines are never copied onto every coupon.
A complete immutable history of every coupon state is not yet recorded.

rows.title: Ticket Go Shows
rows.description: Passengers who actually boarded a flight different from their original ticketed flight.
limitations: Original ticket-flight attribution and accepted go-show linkage are not recorded together. Reaccommodation or a manual go-show flag alone does not establish this event.

rows.title: Ticket No Shows
rows.description: Passengers with a current open local coupon and no recorded check-in after explicit DCS close.
limitations: Ticket and coupon fields describe AIS local documents. They do not certify external carrier issuance, uplift or settlement.
Current seats and DCS attendance/history are checked per passenger and sector. Offloaded, boarded, checked-in and ambiguous legacy booking-wide check-ins are not called no-shows.

rows.title: Tickets without bookings
rows.description: Current open or checked-in local coupons with a missing, cancelled, deleted or removed booking sector.
limitations: Ticket and coupon fields describe AIS local documents. They do not certify external carrier issuance, uplift or settlement.
Names are returned only when the passenger belongs to the same booking and tenant. Cross-tenant malformed booking links are excluded.

rows.title: Ticket Status
rows.description: Current states of local coupons whose document rows were created during the selected UTC period.
limitations: Ticket numbers and coupon states are AIS local document records. Local creation can materialize a legacy document; it does not prove an external carrier issue time or acceptance.
This is current status by local record creation date, not a historical status-at-cutoff reconstruction.

rows.title: Ticket Used
rows.description: Used local coupons with one matching uplift receipt; a partially used document remains identifiable by coupon number.
limitations: Only an F coupon with exactly one matching persisted coupon_uplift receipt is included. Check-in, boarding and completed flight status alone are insufficient. Production uplift ingestion remains subject to external acceptance.

rows.title: Tickets Voided
rows.description: Persisted coupon-void events by event time, retaining a prior V transition after a subsequent refund.
limitations: Reads retained transactional outbox closure receipts. Legacy changes without receipts and pruned outbox history cannot be reconstructed; current V state is not substituted for a void event.

rows.title: VRS Messages
rows.description: Recorded outbound Type-B message transmissions created in the UTC period, retaining draft, sending and acknowledgment states separately.
limitations: No complete generated-email ledger exists. These are Type-B transmission metadata, not a combined email/TTY history; content and provider payloads are excluded.

rows.title: Web Bookings without Credit Card Authorizations
rows.description: IBE bookings missing a required card authorization.
limitations: A trusted IBE channel and card authorization register are required. A provider payment ID or pending state is not an authorization code.

rows.title: Web Bookings On TTL
rows.description: IBE bookings holding inventory under an actual ticketing time limit.
limitations: An authoritative IBE channel and ticketing deadline are not recorded. Inventory lock or checkout expiry is not substituted for a commercial ticketing time limit.
